title: Bounds on the miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $t$ and $s$ be vertices. For every nonnegative integer $k$, the probability that a length-$k$ sequence of uniformly chosen neighbor slots, started at $s$, fails to visit $t$ lies between $0$ and $1$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
